verdict.rationale: Finix docs show core ledger-adjacent capabilities: seller payout management, balance top-ups, fee customization/monetization tools, disputes tracking, webhooks for state changes, and 10+ automated report types covering transactions, disputes, and fees. These support per-seller and per-fee-account visibility and traceability, but no evidence explicitly describes a unified ledger view, split-level traceability from charge through payout, or penny-level reconciliation tooling. missing for 10: explicit reconciliation/ledger reporting to the penny, documented charge-to-payout split traceability, consolidated balance-by-seller-and-fee-account view.
